sloka: विश्वामित्रम् पुरस्कृत्य पितुः पादौ उपस्पृशन् ।राजा च राघवौ पुत्रौ निशाम्य परिहर्षितः ॥१-६९-१८॥
transliteration: viśvāmitram puraskṛtya pituḥ pādau upaspṛśan ।rājā ca rāghavau putrau niśāmya pariharṣitaḥ ॥1-69-18॥

translations.english: Mighty philosopher Janaka also performed the sacrificial rites and spent the night (there where the sacrificial ceremony was performed) with both his daughters. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे एकोनसप्ततितमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the sixtynineth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
